subject: AWS Marketplace listing interest — quick intro + demo
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudadopt.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Interest from AWS Marketplace listing — demo request

Hi Aditya,

We found Redwood on the AWS Marketplace and would like a quick intro and demo to evaluate for a pilot. We're particularly interested in latency profiles, private deployment (VPC), and cost controls for inference workloads running in EKS.

Can we schedule a 30-minute demo next week? Our initial availability is:
- Tue 2026-11-23 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 2026-11-24 14:00–16:00 PT

I've attached a short overview and our internal infra notes.

Best,
Sonia Patel
Head of Platform
CloudAdopt

[Attachment: CloudAdopt-Overview.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: aws-marketplace-inquiry-form.html (text/html)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudadopt.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interest from AWS Marketplace listing — demo request

Hi Sonia — thanks for reaching out and for the attachments.

Quick intro: I'm Aditya on the Redwood sales team. Happy to run a 30-minute demo focused on VPC/private deployment, latency, and cost controls. Laura Bennett (cc'd) is our AM and will join to cover customer fit and pricing.

I have the following windows next week (PT):
- Tue 11/23 10:30–11:00
- Tue 11/23 11:30–12:00
- Wed 11/24 14:30–15:00

You can also pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/aditya/30

If you can confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite and agenda; we'll include a short pre-demo checklist so we can tailor the session to your infra.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference

[Calendaring link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/aditya/30]

From: Sonia Patel <sonia@cloudadopt.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interest from AWS Marketplace listing — demo request

Aditya — thanks for the quick reply.

Tue 11/23 11:30–12:00 PT works for us. Please include:
- Short run-through of VPC deployment options (VPC peering vs private link)
- SAML/Sso and KMS/HSM integrations
- Token cost per inference example for batch vs streaming

Attaching a 1-pager on our current infra and a list of internal stakeholders.

See you then,
Sonia
